name: timbrockman.com
postCreateCommand: yes | npm install -g agent-browser && yes | agent-browser install --with-deps
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'if ! pgrep -f "eleventy --serve" >/dev/null; then npm run start -- --host "$HOST" --port "$PORT" >/tmp/eleventy.log 2>&1 & fi; for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/" >/dev/null && echo "Preview ready on port ${PORT}" && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "Preview not ready after 90s"; exit 1'
